Trace, implement and test: LCS 03. 主题空间

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> p;

    int largestArea(vector<string>& grid) {
        int m = grid.size(), n = grid[0].size();
        p.resize(m * n + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < p.size(); ++i) p[i] = i;
        vector<int> size(m * n + 1, 1);
        vector<int> dirs = {-1, 0, 1, 0, -1};
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (i == 0 || i == m - 1 || j == 0 || j == n - 1 || grid[i][j] == '0')
                    p[find(i * n + j)] = find(m * n);
                else {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int x = i + dirs[k], y = j + dirs[k + 1];
                        if ((grid[x][y] == '0' || grid[i][j] == grid[x][y]) && find(x * n + y) != find(i * n + j)) {
                            size[find(x * n + y)] += size[find(i * n + j)];
                            p[find(i * n + j)] = find(x * n + y);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (find(i * n + j) != find(m * n))
                    ans = max(ans, size[i * n + j]);
        return ans;
    }

    int find(int x) {
        if (p[x] != x) p[x] = find(p[x]);
        return p[x];
    }
};
